description.zh:
账号名称。 

> 仅支持重置高权限账号。
description.en:
The username of the account.

> You can reset only the permissions of a privileged account.

description.zh:
账号密码，密码需满足如下要求： 

- 大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符至少占三种。 
- 长度为8~32位。
- 特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=` 。
description.en:
The password of the account. The password must meet the following requirements:

- It must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

- Special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

descriptions.zh:
> * 仅支持重置PolarDB MySQL版集群的高权限账号。
> *  如果高权限账号自身出现问题，例如权限被意外回收（REVOKE ），您可以通过重置高权限账号的权限，使其恢复正常。
descriptions.en:
> - Only PolarDB for MySQL clusters support this operation.
>
> - If the privileged account of your cluster encounters exceptions, you can reset the permissions by using this operation. For example, the permissions are accidentally revoked.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb reset-account --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --account-name testacc --account-password Pw123456 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ResetAccount --region cn-hangzhou --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --AccountName testacc --AccountPassword Pw123456
